This looks correct and complete. All requirements are satisfied.

## Summary

Added slug-based post URLs while keeping the legacy numeric address working as a permanent redirect.

- **`db/schema.ts`**: added a `slug` (`text`, not null, unique) column to `posts`.
- **`db/migrations/20260818071027_add_posts_slug/`**: hand-written migration (drizzle-kit's auto-generated SQL was broken — it emitted a doomed `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN slug NOT NULL` with no default on a non-empty table). The real migration rebuilds the table, backfilling existing rows with `'post-' || id` so old data gets a well-formed, unique slug; verified it against a simulated pre-migration SQLite file.
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`**: added `Post.slugify(title)` (lowercase, ASCII-only, hyphen-joined, no leading/trailing hyphen) and `Post.uniqueSlug(base)` (appends `-2`, `-3`, ... for collisions).
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `store()` generates the slug once at creation and redirects there; `update()` never touches slug (stability) and redirects to the slug URL; `show()` now takes `:slug`, treats a purely numeric value as the legacy id (301 redirect to `/posts/<slug>`, 404 if unknown), otherwise looks up by slug (404 if unknown).
- **`routes/web.ts`**: `posts.show` route path changed to `/:slug` (edit/update/destroy remain id-based, unchanged).
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: added `PostSlugParamSchema`.
- **`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`**: `PostResourceData` now includes `slug`.
- **`resources/js/pages/Home.tsx`** and **`posts/Index.tsx`**: post links now point at the slug URL.
- **`db/seeders/002_posts.ts`**: sample posts given explicit slugs.
- Regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` via `bunx guren codegen --force`.
- Added `tests/PostSlug.test.ts` covering slugify formatting, duplicate-title numbering, slug stability across title edits, the 301 legacy redirect, 404s, and the `slug` field on the props sent to the page.

`bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (8/8 passing), and `bunx guren check` all pass.
